archetypes.name: Warrior
archetypes.description: A strong and resilient fighter. Extremely skilled in combat and physical challenges, but not very good at magic or social interactions.

features.name: fighter
features.description: The character has fighting experience, and so has an advantage in physical combat.

equippedItems.name: sword
equippedItems.description: A simple straight sword, useful in combat.

equippedItems.name: shield
equippedItems.description: A simple round shield, good for self defense.

archetypes.name: Explorer
archetypes.description: A stealthy and agile character, excelling in survival and quick reflexes. Knows his way in both fighting and spellcasting, but is not an expert in any of those.

features.name: survivalist
features.description: The character knows their way in the nature and can get out from difficult situations.

equippedItems.name: leather_boots
equippedItems.description: Robust leather boots, perfect for exploration in the wild

equippedItems.name: rope
equippedItems.description: An old but still functioning rope, can be used in multiple creative ways.

archetypes.name: Mage
archetypes.description: A master of arcane arts, possessing vast knowledge and powerful spells. Extremely skilled in the use of magic, but not very good at fighting or physical challenges.

features.name: spellcaster
features.description: The character is proficient in the use of magic, being able to cast better and more powerful spells.

equippedItems.name: book_of_knowledge
equippedItems.description: A book containing ancient knowledge, which most consider to be lost

equippedItems.name: necklace_of_influence
equippedItems.description: An enchanted talisman, which makes the wearer appear more charming.

archetypes.name: Bard
archetypes.description: A charismatic performer and storyteller, skilled in music, lore, and social interactions. Can fight and use magic, but is not an expert in any of those.

features.name: smoothtalker
features.description: The character knows how to use words to convince, intimidate or deceive others.

equippedItems.name: violin
equippedItems.description: A well made violin, produces a clear and sweet sound.

equippedItems.name: silk_gloves
equippedItems.description: Silky, delicate gloves, helps improving the manual skills of the wearer.

goals.name: crown
goals.description:
Retrieve the Mystic Crown of the Fallen King.
The Mystic Crown is said to be able to grant a single wish of its bearer.

goals.name: shadowmancer
goals.description:
Defeat the evil Shadowmancer.
The Shadowmancer is an evil sorcerer which plans to plunge the world in darkness.

goals.name: treasure
goals.description:
Find the treasure of the Fallen King.
This treasure is said to be immense, and contains gems worth more then entire kingdoms.
